"The person who agrees with you 80 percent of the time is a friend and an ally -- not a 20 percent traitor." Ronald Reagan famously said,
From Nixon and Rockefeller to Bush and Cheney, from Boehner and McConnell to Graham and Cornyn, and now to something far stranger--the Republican Party has spent the better part of six decades fighting over what it means to be a "real" conservative. For years, the right's internal critics had a handy label for those they viewed as too accommodating to the entrenched Washington order: RINO--Republican In Name Only. It was a pejorative hurled at members who voted with Democrats on spending, sided with the Beltway consensus on foreign wars, or rolled their eyes at grassroots activism. But 2026 has revealed a phenomenon far worse than any RINO. Call them what they are: NERINOs--Not Even Republicans In Name Only.
The term "RINO" had a certain logic to it. George W. Bush entered the White House promising "compassionate conservatism," oversaw an explosion in federal spending, and left office with the conservative base disillusioned. Dick Cheney, after eight years as the embodiment of the GOP hawkish establishment, became a vocal critic of his own party's populist turn. John McCain built an entire career on being the Republican the media loved precisely because he was willing to undermine his own side. Lindsey Graham and John Cornyn perfected the art of talking like conservatives during primary season while legislating like moderates once safely sworn in. These were Republicans who at least started inside the party, campaigned under its banner, and accepted its institutional traditions, even if they consistently disappointed its voters.

clean_body: Convicted because of a cooler | | | | | | Dear Fellow American,This officer was just convicted of manslaughter for trying to stop a fleeing criminal with non-lethal force. Sgt. Erik Duran dedicated 15 years of his life to the NYPD.He earned dozens of commendations. He helped take illegal guns off the streets. He put his life on the line to protect his community. Now he's fighting for his own freedom – All because of a split-second decision he made during a drug bust in the Bronx. | | | | | An undercover officer had just purchased narcotics from a suspect. As officers moved in to make the arrest, the suspect jumped on a motorized scooter and fled.Duran had only moments to react.He didn't reach for his firearm.He didn't use deadly force. Instead, he grabbed a nearby cooler and threw it into the suspect's path to stop him. The suspect crashed and later died from his injuries.Now, Sgt. Duran has been convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to prison.And he is fighting to clear his name through the appeals process. This appeal is his only chance to avoid spending the next 9 years behind bars with the very criminals he spent his career putting away. The Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) is standing with Sgt. Duran and helping fund his appeal.But legal battles like this are long, difficult, and incredibly expensive.And while Erik fights for his freedom, his wife and children are left carrying the burden alongside him. They’re not only facing the reality of their husband and father spending the next 9 years in prison.Their own lives have been threatened because of this case. That's why I’m asking for your help today. spent 15 years protecting others. Now he needs people like you standing behind him. you for standing with Sgt. Duran. Sincerely, | | | Jason Johnson, President Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit www.leldf.org. **NEW POLL SHOWS THAT THE RACE FOR OH-01 IN VIRTUAL TIE**
_Polling shows that the race for Southwest Ohio is near a toss-up_

---
| |

**Cincinnati, OH** — A new poll was conducted by Quantus Insights fielded August 21-24, 2026. The public poll shows that Greg Landsman leads Eric Conroy 47.9 to 44.6, a 3.3-point gap inside the survey’s own margin of error of 4.6 percent with the incumbent below 50 after 2 terms in Congress. The race for Ohio’s 1st Congressional District is in a virtual dead heat with undecided voters breaking to Conroy three to one. This shows that with 10 weeks to go, and the late movement belonging to Conroy, the race is anyone’s to win.
Conroy has the momentum behind him and the ability to flip this seat. Vice President JD Vance came to Cincinnati’s west side last week to campaign with Conroy. Additionally, National Republicans have already committed $5 million to help flip this seat. This investment comes at a time when, according to the survey, 38.3 percent of the district still has no opinion of the Republican nominee. The combined efforts of Conroy for Congress, and National Republicans will drive undecided voters to Conroy’s campaign.
_“The recent poll shows that our campaign is continuing to move in the right direction. Greg Landsman’s radical policies do not align with the values of this district. I will continue to champion common-sense policies that we know will make Cincinnati a better place for families to live and our region to thrive. I look forward to continuing to build on our momentum as we head into the fall”_ \- Eric Conroy
As we head into Labor Day, and the fall campaigning gets underway, it is clear that Eric Conroy has the momentum and national support needed to flip one of the most highly contested races in the country. The Conroy campaign will continue to work everyday to highlight Conroy’s message to voters: to create a more affordable and prosperous Southwest Ohio.
See more from Quantus Insights: [HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/Rs9CalipVnh?e=3f87e575ad&c2id=83ae238fa0f76420f201b2501cd8e566)

Peter, most of Trump's attacks on democracy aren't secretive. He and his MAGA-allies are attacking democracy in plain sight. The brazen gerrymandering, for example, is right out there in the open. Republicans are trying to rig the maps, and it’s happening across the country. **But one thing that hasn't gotten a lot of attention is the Trump administration's efforts to keep brand-new American citizens from voting.** That's right: _citizens. _ For the last year, Trump has prevented new Americans from getting help with voter registration. While a federal judge finally took action to put a stop to this cynical maneuver this month — we know that Trump and MAGA are relentless when it comes to suppressing our votes. **It’s why we need to be just as relentless.[The NDRC is fighting for every last American's right to exercise their vote and to defend our democracy, and that work is funded by people like you — will you make a donation today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138131771/643123835/1548394306?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_TrumpsQuietPlan_email_20260829-NDRC-Tier1-TrumpsQuietPlan_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260829-NDRC-Tier1-TrumpsQuietPlan_&utm_campaign=TrumpsQuietPlan&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjIwNTY1NGVkLWFhYTMtZjExMS05YjMzLTAwMjI0ODJhOWE4ZCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=N3Y_1hWg3LRBRQl8MkwjGMs-fYk1QQ9VErq_swt_KDk=)** Thank you, Art Mitchell

| | | | Dear Friend, Will you help me put God back in your town schools? Specifically, I'm asking you to sign the "[**Schools Need a Bible Revival**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)" petition and tell your Governor that the children in your community deserve to hear that: They are wonderfully made in the very image of God. And that God is calling them to love Him above all else. What a country we'd be, if all of America's children had just a little bit of God's Word in their lives - like you did. But in 1963, in a wrongly decided Supreme Court case, the Left ripped the everyday reading of the Bible out of public schools. **And the results speak for themselves: more violence, divorce, abortion, drug addiction, depression, and the breakdown of the family.** It is only fitting that during the 250th Anniversary of our independence, we put Biblical lessons BACK into our public schools. **[That's why I'm spearheading a nationwide Bible Revival in public schools and asking you to join me today.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** Your signature on your "[**Schools Need a Bible Revival**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)" petition tells our representatives that you want biblical lessons put back in schools. Your signed "**[Schools Need a Bible Revival](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** " petition is going straight to my friends at **BRAVE FOR GOOD**. **BRAVE FOR GOOD** is the powerhouse group behind my "See You at the Library" movement featured on Fox News, that gets conservative Story Hours into public libraries to counter the Left's "Drag Queen Story Hours." **BRAVE FOR GOOD** is the powerhouse group that got an historic conservative Story Hour into the Library of Congress last year! And **BRAVE FOR GOOD** is the powerhouse group that will get the Biblical values you cherish - and that America was founded upon - **back into public schools this year!** HOW? We've designed a mini-curriculum for America's 250th Anniversary that teaches children about the role of the Bible in our nation's Founding and emphasizes the Founding values that have made our country great. Last year I got into three public schools to reach 1,400 children with biblical lessons. **[With you and BRAVE FOR GOOD behind me, I know we can expand that number to 250,000 children this year in honor of America's 250th Anniversary.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** That's why **BRAVE FOR GOOD** is getting ready for the battle by collecting stacks of petitions. Your signed "**[Schools Need a Bible Revival](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** " petition tells our representatives that the Supreme Court ruling that took the Bible out of schools only specified that the Bible could not be mandatory reading. The 1963 ruling 100% allows for the Bible to be taught in a historical or cultural context! And why wouldn’t it be? In every corner of the world, the Bible is considered one of the greatest books ever written. Of course children should learn about it in your taxpayer-funded schools! But radical educators will try to keep anything to do with the Bible out of our schools and when they do, **BRAVE FOR GOOD** will be ready to counter them with thousands of signed petitions. **[But that means getting your signed "Schools Need a Bible Revival" petition back now. And will you please also consider a tax-deductible petition sponsorship gift of $35 or more?](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** Every petition you send digitally must still be delivered, verified, securely collected, and tabulated before it can be presented - and **[your $35 covers those costs for 400 more signers.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) **That means your gift today puts hundreds of new voices on the record before the deadline. Together with **BRAVE FOR GOOD** and patriots like you, we got conservative and patriotic values back into public libraries. _Now we're going to get biblical values back into public schools._ Only God can lead our nation back to His Word. **But you and I are called to do our part too.** Thank you for standing with us. May God bless you,

We have 43 canvasses planned in swing districts and states across the country, in addition to virtual phone banks.
#
Hi there,
**Are you free today? If so, consider joining us for our[Ground Truth Weekend of Action!](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2315?tag_ids=24436%3Futm_source%3Dem20260829-2611&t=1&akid=2611%2E1562180%2EN9sErK)**
We have 43 canvasses planned in swing districts and states across the country, in addition to virtual phone banks that you can participate in from the comfort of your own home.
We’re working toward our goal of having 500,000 substantive conversations with voters before Election Day, and we need your help to get there. We’re at 15,000 conversations so far, and over the next few weeks, this work is going to multiply.
By talking directly with people in the communities that will decide these close races, you can help learn what matters most to voters and gather insights that campaigns can use to be responsive to voters’ needs and smarter with their messaging, targeting, and outreach.
With less than 10 weeks until Election Day, every conversation we have helps build the relationships and organizing power we’ll need to help Democrats flip the House and Senate.
**So if you can, please join us for a Ground Truth canvass or phone bank this weekend. No prior experience is needed—we’ll make sure you’re trained up before you get started!**
**[Sign Up To Canvass](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2315?tag_ids=24436%3Futm_source%3Dem20260829-2611&t=2&akid=2611%2E1562180%2EN9sErK)**

— The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. body:
3 days left until Patrick Roath’s primary — we need your support to help him win on Tuesday.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260829-1&t=1&akid=3943%2E587540%2EGiLXul)
Peter,
We only have **3 days** left until Patrick Roath’s primary — and I really need you to hear me on this one.
Patrick is taking on Stephen Lynch, one of the most conservative Democrats in Congress. During his _twenty-five_ years in Congress, Lynch voted for the Laken Riley Act, voted with Trump multiple times to support ICE, voted against the Affordable Care Act, and up until a few years ago, he was proudly an anti-choice Democrat. It’s time for new leadership in MA-08.
**Lynch is exactly the kind of Democrat we need to primary if we’re serious about transforming the Democratic Party into one that actually fights for working people.**
Patrick gets it. He’s bringing real urgency, passion, and commitment to the issues voters care about most. That’s why he’s ignited such hope and excitement in Democrats across this district. He’s giving them something to believe in, not more of the status quo.
This is our _last_ primary of the season, Peter, and our last incumbent challenge.
**Patrick has what it takes to win, but these last few days are mission critical.** This is the moment we really need to have Patrick’s back. With your support, we can give him a final boost to make sure that without a shadow of a doubt, _Tuesday will be a win._

name: Matias, United We Dream
subject: What we launched on a hot August night
body:
Together, we strengthen our communities for a safer and better future. | | | Peter, **** On a hot Wednesday night in the middle of August, UWD community members from across the country joined a block party from their front porch, a patio, a park bench, anywhere they could. On that call, **we launched five teams** — event leads, outreach leads, storytelling, school and community chapters — so that anyone who wants to organize has somewhere concrete to plug in. We put out a public calendar of community calls and trainings running from September through January, so nobody has to wonder when the next one is. And we introduced people to the organizer who covers their region by name. **[None of this infrastructure is free. Facilitators, interpretation, training curriculum, toolkits that go out to a chapter leader in Connecticut and an outreach lead in Idaho — that's what your donation helps build. Chip in $10 or more today to help us keep that door open.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqswjENXoYacFGtlMLXh6NAeIGjw8YzSH_UAUmMq7WLV0krCNSeQgLJ3AAolc0INa2eEoZh7UZ6aIJfquYSmd-trHtTy817GMyteOzsmWM4z-yc12KofG-i75qQxlmM3ep3RzegbR5yZXwt2nyrrTs8rLP4gWgFflVFvzu3iLMdtdhIOjA-Y_SEIBS1IYzw30GnYPA1xH7zbaTYc5T0ardrmTfAbX4ArnXEN1wfUbEsvVvuQgQAIj3ehu-aVfIW046N9JUAFy0172vt-7bx2NHWlF8exoAkWZatJyILMpDeIOXFFNKeNXRjW6P3FW_16-IGorVu4jQrxa_2g89Vsq-roLs2sX_OH2fpROywHhwpTW-eOa66LK74HappqH_9jEQDjBbNUXBb9VWzjCZv20tUGt9HbFjX881C9bssvmvyuRuLK5srwqnlKoTf7_z70EM2UWEoHXa6ivzDTEOZsOhHtsJxyYnONLLGbkaGhs_Dkrw/4tl/c6w6pGMsRgatoTArHew5wQ/h0/h001.0NBTFwFwfJcTu-u-5NNWk58OFPw3T0gxhpjqFH_e0N0)** We started the August block party where we always start: with our story. Young people in 2007 who were given a coat room instead of a seat at the table, and who decided to build their own. _Five years later, that decision became DACA — the first major immigration policy win in over 25 years._ **Our power has always come from community.** When working people organize as a collective, we build the strength to protect our rights, change our conditions, and build the futures our communities need. That's how we win safety and stability for all of us. The discharge petition to force a House vote on the Dream & Promise Act needs 218 signatures. Getting there takes people in districts making calls, hosting power hours, telling their own stories. That's not a mailing list. That's a base. **[We're still here: organizing, opening doors, and refusing to stay silent. And with every block party, community event, and training, we're making the impossible inevitable. clean_body: Together, we strengthen our communities for a safer and better future. | | | Peter, ** On a hot Wednesday night in the middle of August, UWD community members from across the country joined a block party from their front porch, a patio, a park bench, anywhere they could. On that call, we launched five teams — event leads, outreach leads, storytelling, school and community chapters — so that anyone who wants to organize has somewhere concrete to plug in. We put out a public calendar of community calls and trainings running from September through January, so nobody has to wonder when the next one is. And we introduced people to the organizer who covers their region by name. We started the August block party where we always start: with our story. Young people in 2007 who were given a coat room instead of a seat at the table, and who decided to build their own. Five years later, that decision became DACA — the first major immigration policy win in over 25 years. Our power has always come from community. When working people organize as a collective, we build the strength to protect our rights, change our conditions, and build the futures our communities need. That's how we win safety and stability for all of us. The discharge petition to force a House vote on the Dream & Promise Act needs 218 signatures. Getting there takes people in districts making calls, hosting power hours, telling their own stories. That's not a mailing list. That's a base. ** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | In solidarity, Matias, United We Dream P.S. Peter, I had many sleepless nights in Washington to ensure that **YOU** don’t have to foot the bill for unconstitutional government tax stamps on rifles and suppressors. **Now, any law-abiding gun owner can save $200 on taxes because that unconstitutional tax stamp is officially zeroed out – but the fight isn’t over yet.** **A $0 tax stamp does NOT eliminate the ATF’s unconstitutional registration schemes, wait times, or intrusive approval requirements.** Big Government still thinks it has the right to track law-abiding citizens for exercising a fundamental constitutional right. **That’s why I’m pushing to kill remaining NFA restrictions once and for all.**

There is a peculiar phenomenon in modern intellectual life: the persistence of Karl Marx as a credible figure in economics and social theory. More than three decades have passed since the collapse of the Soviet bloc, an event that ought to have settled the question of socialism in practice. Yet Marx persists. His concepts--surplus value, exploitation, class conflict--remain staples of undergraduate reading lists, newspaper editorials, and political rhetoric. This endurance is all the more remarkable because the theoretical demolition of Marxism was accomplished over a century ago. The Austrian School of economics delivered not merely criticisms but refutations that struck at the logical foundations of the entire Marxian system. That these refutations remain obscure in university curricula and mainstream discourse says less about their intellectual merit than about the ideological preferences of the institutions that shape public opinion.

clean_body: Don’t listen to them. | | | | Everyone doubted us. They didn’t believe that we could win in 2018, but we made history. Right here in Wisconsin, we pulled off a major victory when Democrats, Independents, and even some Republicans came together to help me defeat Scott Walker in 2018. It was the first time in over a decade that a Democrat sat in the Governor’s office, and when we won, we made historic investments in our infrastructure, schools, and economy. But, Derek, believe me when I tell you Tom Tiffany is worse than Scott Walker. If he has his way, all of our progress could be destroyed. Democrats want to invest in Wisconsin; MAGA wants to invest in themselves. That is why I am dedicated to electing David Crowley in November. Google acquired Nest for $3.2 billion.

Amazon acquired Ring for $1.2 billion.

Both took an ordinary part of the home and made it smart.

RYSE believes another category is ready for the same transformation:

**Your windows.**

Around 92% of window shades are still manually controlled. RYSE has developed patented retrofit technology designed to automate the shades, blinds, and curtains people already own without requiring them to replace their existing window coverings.

And RYSE already has traction:

**100,000+ devices sold.
$20 million+ in revenue.
10 granted patents.
$15 million+ raised from 4,000+ investors.**

Now everyday investors have an opportunity to invest in RYSE through its Regulation A+ offering at **$2.50 per share**.

But that price is set to change **August 31.**

Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. **Democrats in Florida just nominated a self-proclaimed socialist in the biggest Senate special election of 2026.**
_**Her name is Angie Nixon. ** _
She publicly and proudly joined the Democratic Socialists of America during her campaign.
She’s a former “community organizer” who literally runs a bookstore called Cafe Resistance.
She’s endorsed by The Squad and held one of her final rallies with Hamas superfan Rashida Tlaib.
**And she just defeated an incredibly well-funded Democrat with a nearly $17 million war chest** _**by more than ten points after raising less than a million dollars.** _
This is not a fringe candidate who stumbled into a nomination. And the socialist movement gobbling up seats all across the country can no longer be excused as some obscure “wing” of the Democratic Party.
**The heart and soul and energy of the Democrats is now with the socialists, and with the support of President Trump and patriots all across the nation, I’m ready to bury this twisted ideology in Florida.**
You and I love this country. We love freedom, the rule of law, and the belief that hard work and responsibility matter. We do not get up every day and work hard, raise our families and build our communities just to see the evil and failed socialist ideology destroy everything we love.
_**This is the line in the sand.** _

name: Team Molly
subject: Why I’m supporting Molly Gray
body:
Dear Peter, **After winning the Democratic nomination, I’m proud to support Molly Gray in her re-election as Lt. Governor and hope you will join me.** Many of you know Molly’s story. She was born and raised on a vegetable and dairy farm in South Newbury still run by her family, and is a proud product of our Vermont education system. But what you might not know is that straight out of UVM at 22 years of age, she helped elect me to Congress in 2006 then moved to Washington serving on my Congressional staff. Since then, I’ve watched Molly dedicate her career to fighting for the rights of others and — as a human rights advocate and attorney, an Assistant Attorney General, and our Vermont Lt Governor from 2021 to 2023. But what has impressed me most is what she has done since her term ended. She helped build and lead the [Vermont Afghan Alliance](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138143545/643164400/-1532783214?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NjBiNjdjYi1iOGEzLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xO_aiN-ret6m0VzVjkJZMOAgZVrtxMS87lCDIRhx2pI=&emci=2c4d904e-b8a3-f111-9b33-0022482a9a8d&emdi=760b67cb-b8a3-f111-9b33-0022482a9a8d&ceid=43402276), transforming a grassroots volunteer effort into a statewide organization that has helped approximately 650 Afghan allies establish new lives in Vermont. Through driving lessons, housing assistance, job placement, immigration support, and more, Molly has helped grow Vermont’s workforce while helping us keep our promise to those who risked everything for our government. Molly witnessed the cruelty and inhumanity of the Trump Administration up close, and has been working to hold the line and fight back. When Trump tried to defund the Alliance, Molly raised the funds to keep it going. When ICE wrongfully detained an Afghan man, Molly rallied immigration attorneys and prevented his deportation. When Vermont wrongfully ended SNAP for some Afghans, Molly worked with the legislature, attorneys and the Congressional Delegation to get it reinstated. Rather than remain silent, she has continued to speak out and stand up for Vermont’s values. Molly also became a mom, and has helped care for her mother who battles multiple sclerosis. She has experienced firsthand the pressures facing working families in Vermont from rising costs to a healthcare system in crisis. That is why Molly is running for Lieutenant Governor. She understands what the office can be. She is committed to protecting fundamental rights, supporting working families, and making strategic investments that lower costs for all Vermonters Molly has the experience, determination, and courage to lead during these difficult times. Vermonters deserve a Lieutenant Governor who will not hesitate to speak out, fight for our state, be a reliable partner for me and our Congressional delegation, and hold the line. **I’m all in on supporting Molly and hope you will join us by chipping in today here: [**ht** tps://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-pwmg](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138143546/643164401/-352367368?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NjBiNjdjYi1iOGEzLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xO_aiN-ret6m0VzVjkJZMOAgZVrtxMS87lCDIRhx2pI=)**.

subject: Why I’m asking Virginians to re-hire me.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia1490-5A Quarterpath Road #272Williamsburg, VA 23185

_Derek, this is a longer email than I normally send, but it’s deeply personal to me. I know I ask for your support often, and you deserve to know why I’m asking Virginians to re-hire me, and why I decided to run for office in the first place.

**[If you’re short on time and already with me in the fight, then please consider a contribution split between my campaign and Tim Kaine's Common Ground PAC>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138143397/643163933/2022378323?amount=25&refcode=260829em_mrw_tworeasons&refcode2=260829em_mrw_tworeasons&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDQvMS84ODkyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwODNiNzEzNC1iOGEzLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CAe9r1_3vvKtANgghJHq2lrw8WF27fewngNUwKypE7s=)**_
---
**I first ran for public office for two reasons. First, because I believe that every Virginian – and every American – should have the same shot at success that I had.**

I grew up in a middle class family, went to public school, and was the first in my family to graduate from college.

I then tried to get into business, and failed in about six weeks. My next attempt failed in six months. I was incredibly fortunate that my third venture broke through, and that I continued to see success throughout my career in the telecommunications industry.

Success should _never_ depend on where you were born, who your parents are, or whether you had the right connections.

**Second, I got into politics because I believe you shouldn’t have to leave your hometown to find a world class job.** Success cannot depend on luck or geography. You should be able to build a good life in any zip code in Virginia.

It all comes down to this: Where you start should never determine where you end up. And it’s not lost on me – we’ve got a lot more work to do to make that a reality.

That’s why I’m asking Virginians to re-hire me one last time – and elect Democrats up and down the ballot who will stand up to this administration’s actions that are raising costs, fight for our communities, and offer a better path forward for our country.

clean_body: | | | | | | | Derek, this is a longer email than I normally send, but it’s deeply personal to me. I know I ask for your support often, and you deserve to know why I’m asking Virginians to re-hire me, and why I decided to run for office in the first place. = I first ran for public office for two reasons. First, because I believe that every Virginian – and every American – should have the same shot at success that I had. I grew up in a middle class family, went to public school, and was the first in my family to graduate from college. I then tried to get into business, and failed in about six weeks. My next attempt failed in six months. I was incredibly fortunate that my third venture broke through, and that I continued to see success throughout my career in the telecommunications industry. Success should never depend on where you were born, who your parents are, or whether you had the right connections. Second, I got into politics because I believe you shouldn’t have to leave your hometown to find a world class job. Success cannot depend on luck or geography. You should be able to build a good life in any zip code in Virginia. It all comes down to this: Where you start should never determine where you end up. And it’s not lost on me – we’ve got a lot more work to do to make that a reality. Hi Peter,John Willoughby here, Kelly's husband. I want to share a story that has become part of our family lore.

Kelly first ran for office in 2018. As an OB-GYN, she knew exactly what Trump's pledge to appoint extreme, anti-abortion justices to the Supreme Court would mean for her patients. So she got off the sidelines, got involved in local campaigns, and started knocking on doors.

One night, after we'd been out door knocking together, we sat down for dinner and realized that no Democrat was stepping up to run against our extreme, right-wing representative in the state House. We looked at each other and knew that one of us had to do it.

_What followed were long conversations with our three kids and a couple of family votes. During one of them, our son – who was 12 at the time – turned to me and said, "Papi, I think Mom would be better."_

_He was right, of course. _

**Our son knew that his mom was pretty damn tough – and that no one was going to work harder or care more than Kelly for the people in our community. **

So Kelly jumped into the race. She knocked on thousands of doors, had thousands of conversations, and won by 216 votes. And she hasn't stopped fighting since.

Our family is incredibly proud of Kelly. We watched her march right up to armed ICE agents at the Whipple Federal Building and demand to be let in to the detention center to conduct oversight. We’ve seen her call out this administration's misinformation around healthcare time and time again, using her decades of understanding of evidence-based medicine to cut through the noise.

And she gets things done: she was the first freshman Democrat to pass a bill through the Republican-controlled House, and she has passed more since.

**Kelly is a real, effective leader, and she’s exactly who we need in Congress right now. But that won’t just happen on its own,_especially now that she’s facing an extreme MAGA opponent in the general election._**

One night, after we'd been out door knocking together, we sat down for dinner and realized that no Democrat was stepping up to run against our extreme, right-wing representative in the state House. We looked at each other and knew that one of us had to do it. What followed were long conversations with our three kids and a couple of family votes. During one of them, our son – who was 12 at the time – turned to me and said, "Papi, I think Mom would be better." He was right, of course. Our son knew that his mom was pretty damn tough – and that no one was going to work harder or care more than Kelly for the people in our community. So Kelly jumped into the race. She knocked on thousands of doors, had thousands of conversations, and won by 216 votes. And she hasn't stopped fighting since. Our family is incredibly proud of Kelly. We watched her march right up to armed ICE agents at the Whipple Federal Building and demand to be let in to the detention center to conduct oversight. We’ve seen her call out this administration's misinformation around healthcare time and time again, using her decades of understanding of evidence-based medicine to cut through the noise. And she gets things done: she was the first freshman Democrat to pass a bill through the Republican-controlled House, and she has passed more since. Kelly is a real, effective leader, and she’s exactly who we need in Congress right now. name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: Their attacks don’t faze me one bit
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tammy Baldwin for Senate
body:
Peter,
Donald Trump, Mike Rogers’ team, and MAGA Republicans have started using my full name — Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed — like it's a weapon. Like the extra syllables are supposed to make you trust me less.
I think that says more about them than it does about me. **That’s because when you don't have a record to run on, you run on fear instead.**
Mike Rogers voted to raise his own pay, took over a million dollars from opioid makers and Wall Street banks, and cashed in for millions the moment he left Congress.
MAGA Republicans know Michiganders won't vote for that record. So instead, they’re hoping they'll vote against my name.
Peter, I've spent my whole life being relatively young, relatively brown, and relatively Muslim. Their attacks don’t faze me one bit.
**What _does_ worry me is the MAGA billionaire network working in the background to prop up Rogers.**
Facts are facts, and it’s clear that Mike Rogers is a weak candidate. But Trump handpicked him, so now, Republicans have to do and spend whatever it takes to get Rogers across the finish line.
**That’s why $51 million in GOP Super PAC money has already been committed to stop the Democratic nominee: me.**
We can't out-spend a $51 million war chest. We never could. But we've never needed to — we just need to out-organize it, one donation and one conversation at a time. **That's exactly how we won the primary, and it's the only way we’ll win this seat in November.**
**[Can I count on your support, Peter? Split a donation of $5 or any amount between my campaign and Tammy Baldwin today:](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/6050?c0=em-ms-tb-20260829-elsayed.Cy5Rue&amount=5&refcode=em20260829-5630&t=1&akid=5630%2E35263%2E0eEcLP)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/6050?c0=em-ms-tb-20260829-elsayed.Cy5Rue&amount=5&refcode=20260829-5630&t=20&akid=5630%2E35263%2E0eEcLP)**
Before this race is over, they're going to throw every stereotype in the book at me — my name, my faith, my family. None of it is going to break our spirit. And none of it is going to stop us from winning.
Your friend in the fight,
Abdul

As we get closer and closer to this election (early voting starts in just 47 days), I find myself thinking back to my first time on the campaign trail and all of the memories and change we made along the way.
North Carolina is special, and I've been grateful to serve this state in different capacities from state legislator to Attorney General and Governor. As Governor, you gave me the opportunity to wake up every morning for eight years and lead the state that I love with all my heart.
It wasn't easy. But we worked hard through good days and tough ones, fighting for working folks and communities across North Carolina. Even with our serious mission we made sure to have some fun along the way.
Here are some of my favorite memories from the campaign trail and my time in office over the years.
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/644bda40-f6f2-4af9-aa9f-f55d5cc09447?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
One snowy afternoon, my kids discovered my yard signs for the North Carolina State Senate made pretty good sleds!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b3043f4f-12d3-463e-bf83-4c0f6fa79312?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This was the moment I was sworn in by taking the oath of office as Attorney General. I still think about what it meant to be trusted with that responsibility as the chief law enforcement officer of the state.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/55582ba6-c686-417d-9fc3-5485e9358285?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Bringing my children to my inaugural event as Attorney General.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/68d7f5cb-2e49-422f-8460-ba107bc1ac43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Photo credit: Mel Nathanson _News & Observer_
Ben wanted to join in on the fun while filming a campaign ad with my daughters.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ac915e6-4653-41fd-bb03-144566dc4a4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
During my time as Governor, we made a lot of amazing progress, including our bipartisan expansion of Medicaid coverage for hundreds of thousands of working North Carolinians.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/657d3ae6-bd54-42d4-b0ad-5acd3793e8ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Delivering my farewell address as Governor and reflecting on eight amazing years that the people of our great state allowed me to serve.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e5b8911c-4d0b-4ea8-85d0-5ef4021022aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Taking a quick break with Violet!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5eb63d46-1acf-4611-9d6d-8b24dab09f68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Some of my favorite conversations with North Carolinians happened right here, at the State Fair, in between carnival games, livestock shows and bites of caramel apples with nuts (my favorite).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/42bf8c04-fa13-4b48-ab07-aa8e4db9e05c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Launching my Make Stuff Cost Less tour and hearing what folks care about all across the state.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/41c0e370-bdc8-4301-a616-740d1e71756c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Getting to hear about what matters to North Carolinians.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e7b63757-3b9e-4b38-b44d-c073bb7b7036?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/644bda40-f6f2-4af9-aa9f-f55d5cc09447?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
Looking back on these moments, I'm reminded of why I ran for office in the first place. The people I met along the way and the communities I fight for remind me how important trusted leadership is. I take that trust seriously and I know what's at stake, I'm committed to making life easier for working folks.
I am grateful for my time in public service, and every memory before and since leaving office. But Washington DC is broken, and I'm ready to bring a little North Carolina common sense up there.
With early voting starting in just 47 days, I hope you'll help me show up for North Carolina one more time.
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/644bda40-f6f2-4af9-aa9f-f55d5cc09447?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Volunteer](https://substack.com/redirect/0c068445-12e3-4530-8d26-fd3fbd806810?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Register to vote](https://substack.com/redirect/e5f272f1-6a69-4036-88fc-58021e943345?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

| | | I want to stop talking in generalities for a minute and show you something specific.
**[When you give to Equal Opportunity Now, your money isn't going into some abstract fund. It's going directly into the battleground states that will decide who controls Congress next year — states like Maine, Arizona, Georgia, and more. Will you chip in $25 or $50 today to help us fund the fighters running there?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138148393/643182469/523564483?refcode=260829_eom2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MzlkY2MwZC1iZmEzLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8cdVR2hvfrwCSXfe2aJivDkvF32P2OC8Od10AmwXJs8=)** Let me show you what that actually looks like.
In Arizona's 1st District: Dr. Amish Shah is running in what may be the single most contested battleground district in the entire country. Republicans have held it through seven straight elections, and in 2022, Democrats came within eight-tenths of one percentage point of flipping it. Amish is an ER physician who passed more bills than any other Democrat in the Arizona legislature. He is exactly the kind of fighter this moment demands.

name: Mark Kelly
subject: My decision:
body:
Hey folks,
it’s Mark Kelly.

Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run
for the Senate.

I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of
time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy.

But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing
just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I
had to do something.

So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run
all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support,
we won that one, too.

I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and
defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the
greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be
here without your help.

I know we’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different.
With elections coming this November, the stakes are higher than they have
ever been. The fate of our democracy hangs in the balance.

After everything that’s already happened, I wish I didn’t have to ask you
for more. But that’s what I need to do.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260829_2.7xUlQU&refcode=em20260829-2&t=1001&akid=8580%2E582294%2EIA4mED ]I’m asking you to split a donation between Chris Pappas and me. We’re
going to do everything we can to take back Congress this November, and
Chris Pappas needs your help. I just hope you know that I wouldn’t be
asking if this wasn’t important.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260829_2.7xUlQU&amount=5&refcode=em20260829-2&t=1020&akid=8580%2E582294%2EIA4mED ]Donate $5 »

Thank you.

Mark

When we sit down to build our Senate strategy for November, we go list by list, zip code by zip code. We look at who responded, what they care about, and where the intensity is. That data is how we decide where to fight, where to spend, and where to hold the line. Democrats are not leaving blank files. Their activists are filling out every survey, returning every call, and showing up at every meeting. They are building the most complete voter intelligence operation this party has ever run -- and they are doing it right now, while most conservatives are still enjoying their summer. I have seen elections lost in the data room before the first ad ever runs. ****************************************************************************************************** Your answers matter. name: NEGOP
subject: Reminder: 🚨 Your Weekly Update From The NEGOP
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Nebraska Republican Party 1610 N St
body:
News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong.
| | | | |
---
| Letter from the Chair
---
| Fellow Nebraska Republicans,
This fall the Republican National Committee is doing something that has never been done before: a national midterm convention. On September 9 and 10 in Dallas, the party will gather at American Airlines Center for a two-night primetime showcase of President Trump's record, the candidates who will carry it forward, and the choice facing voters on November 3.
RNC Chairman Joe Gruters has called it historic. President Trump will appear both nights and deliver the closing keynote on Thursday. Vice President JD Vance headlines Wednesday. Each hour is built around a clear theme: working-family tax relief, border security, trade and American manufacturing, healthcare affordability, lower prescription drug costs, and policies that put families first--including no tax on tips, overtime, and Social Security. Everyday workers and families who have seen results will share the stage alongside candidates from competitive races.
That is the message Nebraska needs to hear and amplify. Our state convention this summer showed Republicans here are activated and ready. Senator Pete Ricketts, Congressmen Mike Flood and Adrian Smith, Attorney General Mike Hilgers, Treasurer Joey Spellerberg, Auditor Mike Foley, Secretary of State nominee Scott Petersen, CD2 nominee Brinker Harding, and RNC Co-Chair KC Crosbie all made the same point: we win when we talk about results and contrast them with a Democratic Party drifting further left. Dallas will put that contrast on national television.
The convention is also a candidate platform. Nightly showcases from 6 to 7 p.m. will introduce Republicans running in the races that decide control of Congress. For Nebraska that means more national attention on keeping our delegation strong and sending reinforcements to Washington who will back tax relief, secure borders, and common-sense energy and agriculture policy that our farmers and ranchers depend on.
Tickets have been allocated through state parties, and--for the first time--the RNC opened a public lottery so grassroots Republicans can attend. Winners were to be notified September 4 at GOPConvention.com. Whether you are in the hall or watching from home, treat those two nights as a kickoff, not a spectator event.
Between now and November, the work is here in Nebraska. County victory rallies, the Five County BBQ, the annual Pete Ricketts Steak Fry, and local campaign walk programs matter more than any speech in Dallas. Watch the convention. Share the stories of tax cuts, border security, and lower drug costs. Volunteer. Talk to neighbors who sat out last time. Then vote--and take someone with you.
President Trump's team and the RNC are putting the American comeback on display. Nebraska Republicans know how to finish the job.
Onward to November. Together We Win!
In Liberty and in Truth,

clean_body: News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong. | | | | | | Letter from the Chair | Fellow Nebraska Republicans, This fall the Republican National Committee is doing something that has never been done before: a national midterm convention. On September 9 and 10 in Dallas, the party will gather at American Airlines Center for a two-night primetime showcase of President Trump's record, the candidates who will carry it forward, and the choice facing voters on November 3. RNC Chairman Joe Gruters has called it historic. President Trump will appear both nights and deliver the closing keynote on Thursday. Vice President JD Vance headlines Wednesday. Each hour is built around a clear theme: working-family tax relief, border security, trade and American manufacturing, healthcare affordability, lower prescription drug costs, and policies that put families first--including no tax on tips, overtime, and Social Security. Everyday workers and families who have seen results will share the stage alongside candidates from competitive races. That is the message Nebraska needs to hear and amplify. Our state convention this summer showed Republicans here are activated and ready. Senator Pete Ricketts, Congressmen Mike Flood and Adrian Smith, Attorney General Mike Hilgers, Treasurer Joey Spellerberg, Auditor Mike Foley, Secretary of State nominee Scott Petersen, CD2 nominee Brinker Harding, and RNC Co-Chair KC Crosbie all made the same point: we win when we talk about results and contrast them with a Democratic Party drifting further left. Dallas will put that contrast on national television. The convention is also a candidate platform. Nightly showcases from 6 to 7 p.m. will introduce Republicans running in the races that decide control of Congress. For Nebraska that means more national attention on keeping our delegation strong and sending reinforcements to Washington who will back tax relief, secure borders, and common-sense energy and agriculture policy that our farmers and ranchers depend on. Tickets have been allocated through state parties, and--for the first time--the RNC opened a public lottery so grassroots Republicans can attend. Winners were to be notified September 4 at GOPConvention.com. Whether you are in the hall or watching from home, treat those two nights as a kickoff, not a spectator event. Between now and November, the work is here in Nebraska. County victory rallies, the Five County BBQ, the annual Pete Ricketts Steak Fry, and local campaign walk programs matter more than any speech in Dallas. Watch the convention. Share the stories of tax cuts, border security, and lower drug costs. Volunteer. Talk to neighbors who sat out last time. Then vote--and take someone with you. President Trump's team and the RNC are putting the American comeback on display. Nebraska Republicans know how to finish the job. Onward to November. Together We Win! Then, a federal judge temporarily blocked the Postal Service from implementing the new restrictions. **But this isn't the first time Trump has tried to interfere with the way Oregonians vote, and it likely won't be the last. For more than 25 years, our vote-by-mail system has made voting safe, secure, and accessible for millions of Oregonians. Now, Trump wants to impose new federal requirements on our elections, including new requirements for mail ballot envelopes and voter information that states must provide to the Postal Service or risk ballots not being delivered. **Today's court order blocks the new restrictions for now, but this fight isn't over.** The Trump administration is already appealing, and the case could return to the Supreme Court. **Since February, we’ve been engaged in a dangerous and reckless war with Iran that was started by our own president, Donald Trump.**
18 Americans have died, thousands of Iranians have been killed, and the livelihoods of people around the world have been threatened. Whatever instability was present in the region beforehand is even worse now, and Trump is showing no signs of ending this war.
**If Trump won’t get us out of this war, Congress needs to do so by immediately passing legislation limiting Trump’s ability to take further military action against Iran.**
We have entered a period where the speed of decision-making is accelerating, while the guardrails that prevent catastrophic miscalculation are weaker than ever. This combination should terrify every American.
Hereʼs what I propose to do in Congress to end this war and build peace at home and abroad:
* Take back Congressʼs authority to declare war.
* Fight for legislation explicitly prohibiting funding for any unauthorized offensive military operation against Iran in defense appropriation legislation.
* Pass legislation prohibiting the US military from using artificial intelligence technology when targeting lethal strikes.
* Push to re-ratify the New START treaty and support efforts to reduce nuclear arsenals in the US and around the world.
* Pass “Back-from-the-Brink” legislation that would ensure that no president has unilateral authority to launch a nuclear strike.
* Invest in international aid by restoring Trump and Elon Muskʼs reckless cuts to USAID.

**[We cannot lose focus, and we must elect leaders who recognize that building peace at home and peace abroad is what makes us all safer. clean_body: An issue a day | | | | With just ten days until the primary, I am using each day to discuss an issue I have highlighted on the campaign trail. For Day 10, I am highlighting the need to promote peace and global stability. Dear David, The greatest responsibility of our federal government is to protect the welfare of the people who call this country home. ~~ | | ~~ Since February, we’ve been engaged in a dangerous and reckless war with Iran that was started by our own president, Donald Trump. 18 Americans have died, thousands of Iranians have been killed, and the livelihoods of people around the world have been threatened. Whatever instability was present in the region beforehand is even worse now, and Trump is showing no signs of ending this war. If Trump won’t get us out of this war, Congress needs to do so by immediately passing legislation limiting Trump’s ability to take further military action against Iran. We have entered a period where the speed of decision-making is accelerating, while the guardrails that prevent catastrophic miscalculation are weaker than ever. This combination should terrify every American. Hereʼs what I propose to do in Congress to end this war and build peace at home and abroad: Take back Congressʼs authority to declare war. Fight for legislation explicitly prohibiting funding for any unauthorized offensive military operation against Iran in defense appropriation legislation. Pass legislation prohibiting the US military from using artificial intelligence technology when targeting lethal strikes. Push to re-ratify the New START treaty and support efforts to reduce nuclear arsenals in the US and around the world. Pass “Back-from-the-Brink” legislation that would ensure that no president has unilateral authority to launch a nuclear strike. Friend, Donald Trump is weaponizing the U.S. Postal Service in an attempt to control who can vote in our elections. Trump’s new Postmaster General is implementing a scheme that requires Secretaries of State to hand over state voter rolls. And anyone who doesn’t appear on the Trump administration’s list of approved voters won’t be able to vote by mail. This latest attack on our right to vote is part of the administration’s broader attacks on our democracy, including Trump’s obsession with passing the so-called _SAVE America Act_ that would disenfranchise tens of millions of voters by, among other things, requiring proof of citizenship documentation to register to vote or change your voter registration. **States run our elections, not the federal government. And the USPS and the Trump administration have no authority to determine who is eligible to vote.** [**Every member of Congress needs to speak out in defense of our constitutional right to vote and reaffirm each state’s authority to run its own elections. The good news is that states are fighting back, with 25 states suing the USPS and the Trump administration to stop this blatantly unconstitutional power grab.
The corrupt Supreme Court has allowed Trump’s scheme to proceed, but this rule is creating chaos in our courts with one lower court judge lifting a nationwide injunction this week, while another issued a temporary restraining order against this USPS scheme.
In my district 60% of voters cast their ballots early, with many utilizing mail-in ballots. This is particularly important for working people who can’t get time off from work to vote; for older voters and people with disabilities who may have mobility issues or trouble securing a ride to the polls; for U.S. service members and citizens living abroad; and for students who may go to school out of state.
During the last presidential election, nearly one-third of all voters voted by mail―roughly 48 million voters. **Now just imagine if the U.S. Postal Service was allowed to decide who should and shouldn’t receive their ballot?!**
**Just as the USPS has done for generations, it must deliver lawful ballots and election information without delays, retaliation, or new political conditions.**

Just as the USPS has done for generations, it must deliver lawful ballots and election information without delays, retaliation, or new political conditions. Thank you for taking action today. I promise to continue defending and expanding our right to vote. clean_body: | Friend, Election experts have been calling MI-08 “Seat 218”, the seat that will decide control of Congress. But what does that actually mean? = The House has 435 voting members, so to win a majority, a party needs exactly 218 seats. Currently, there are 217 districts that lean more Democratic than ours, and 217 that lean more Republican. = That means that our district is right smack in the middle – and whichever way we go will give that party the majority. So when we say that winning this seat is absolutely crucial for regaining control of Congress, we mean it. And right now, we’re sitting at a crossroads, friend. National Republicans know how serious this race is – and that’s why they’re preparing to flood millions into this race to help our MAGA opponent. They’re going to spend whatever it takes to win this seat. A review of recent reporting reveals a disturbing pattern: authorities and institutions responsible for public safety and governance have repeatedly failed to protect citizens, prioritize transparency, or exercise sound judgment. Four key areas demonstrate these failures.
**6G Deployment Without Adequate Safety Testing**
Telecommunications regulators and government agencies are preparing to expose entire populations to largely untested terahertz radiation. According to scientific studies cited in recent reports, terahertz (THz) exposure has been shown to induce DNA damage, genomic instability, impaired neural stem-cell proliferation, disrupted cell-cycle activity, altered gene expression, mitochondrial dysfunction, inflammation, apoptosis, and cell death. One study found that THz radiation caused DNA damage, impaired proliferation, and apoptosis in human neural stem cells--with stronger biological effects at higher intensities and longer exposure durations.
Despite these documented biological impacts, institutional planners are advancing 6G deployment, which will also reportedly enable mass AI brain-chip rollout and allow authorities to track human movement through walls. Peter, this is Adam Schiff.

Investigators in my office uncovered the contracts behind the banners of Donald Trump's face now hanging on federal buildings across Washington — the largest of them eight stories tall at the Department of Health and Human Services, with "America First" printed beside it: [](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/14565?t=10&source={%&akid=2952%2E259176%2E2Z9MxT include_tmpl

---
Here’s what we uncovered: The American people paid for every inch of it, and we have the receipts. $114,000 from the FAA. $39,000 from Interior. A third check from the Labor Department.

The list goes on and on.

**Congress long ago outlawed spending taxpayer dollars on propaganda and self-aggrandizement, and an eight-story-high Donald Trump head certainly qualifies.**

Because I spent years as a federal prosecutor, and I know a pattern of intent when I see one. In every country where democracy gave way to one man, the faces went up on the government buildings first. Not as decoration, and not even as vanity — but to teach the people who paid for those buildings a simple lesson: _all of this belongs to him now._

And yet not one of those buildings belongs to Donald Trump. They belong to the American people, to the taxpayers who funded them. We were never asked, and we do not have to accept it.

There is one check on this president that he cannot fire and cannot intimidate: a Democratic Senate, with the gavels and subpoena power to hold him to account.

The Supreme
Court’s "shadow docket" was supposed to be for real emergencies. But now,
it’s been weaponized.

When Trump loses in a lower court, he runs straight to the Supreme Court
to use the "shadow docket" hoping the conservative justices will bail him
out.

No hearing, no arguments, hardly any real explanation. Just a one- or
two-line order that lets him keep doing exactly what a lower court just
said he couldn't.

More often than not, it works. This is a loophole — and Trump is running
through it faster than any president before him. He hit the same number of
emergency appeals in about five months of his second term that it took the
entire Biden presidency to reach.^1

The result? Immigrants lose protections overnight. Civil servants get
pushed out with no due process. The legal limits on presidential power
quietly disappear.

This is what a captured Court looks like. Untethered from the
Constitution, no transparency, and shifting their own legal standards in
ways that make it easier for Trump and entrenched power to win.

Demand Justice PAC is exposing this scheme and building the public and
political pressure to force real reform. Ethics rules, an expanded bench,
and structural changes that end government-by-shadow-docket for good.

But exposing a rigged system takes resources. Building the pressure to
actually fix it takes more.

KATU: Vance calls on Congressional Republicans to pass SAVE Act during speech [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082926_1&amount=25]
Opponents of voting rights are trying everything they can think of to press Congress to advance stalled legislation that purports to address Trump's often-repeated -- and equally debunked -- claims of widespread election fraud. Vice President J.D. Vance called on Congress again recently, begging them to pass this awful bill ahead of the next election.
The SAVE Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. Now, Trump and his MAGA minions are meeting with U.S. Senators, scheming for ways to get this bill through the Senate ahead of November's midterms.
This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE ACT NOW ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082926_1&amount=35]
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present specific types of proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point. The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
Team, the consequences of a bill like this passing would be catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082926_1&amount=35]

How do we know non-citizen voting is a made up problem? Because red states and conservative-leaning institutions have spent millions in taxpayer money and donor dollars searching for it and finding minimal results.
For example: The pro-Trump Heritage Foundation -- an organization that has funded anti-voting initiatives for decades -- maintains a database of "election crimes." Their own records only list 24 instances of non-citizens voting in U.S. elections from 2003 to 2023 . In other words -- 20 years of elections, millions of votes, and only 24 alleged non-citizen voters.
The conservative CATO Institute says it best: " These investigations affirm what is simply common sense. name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: This election can be won by the young

body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=241041%2E444211%2EpoStTm)
I’m writing this as I fly home to El Paso from a long, hot week in North Texas registering and organizing students, something I’ve been working on for a while now.
In 2018 when we were running for senate all the smart people told me this kind of work was a waste of time. Young people might talk a big game, but they never showed up to vote.
But then maybe I wouldn’t have shown up either if no one had bothered to show up for me.
So we went to every campus in Texas. I could list them all, but you’d get bored. We drew big crowds, held town halls at most all of them where we could listen to each other, where students could ask questions and hold me accountable, where they could join the team and lead the fight on their campus.
Young voter turnout was up over 200% that year from the previous midterm. Those new and previously written off voters powered victories across the board. It’s the year that James Talarico and Colin Allred defeated entrenched incumbent Republicans, when we picked up state senate seats and commissioners courts across the state, and won 19 judgeships in Harris County alone.

Registering students at Cedar Valley College in Dallas.
In the wake of those victories Republicans changed the laws around registering and voting, shut down polling sites on or near campuses and made it harder for students to mail a ballot back to their home county.
As you might expect, we didn’t see 200%+ gains in the following elections.
I started Powered by People to see if we could change that. Initially we focused on voter registration, thinking that if we just helped enough young people get on the rolls they’d do the rest. The problem with that is that Texas doesn’t just make it hard to register, they make it hard to vote.
Millions of registered Texans didn’t cast a ballot in the 2022 midterms when the Texas abortion ban, the Uvalde shootings and the collapse of our power grid were all on the ballot.
It wasn’t like people didn’t care about this stuff. But when polling place closures force you to stand in a line 8 hours long to cast your ballot, when you can use your license to carry a gun to vote but can’t use your student I.D. to do the same, when they’ve drawn you out of a district where your vote could make a difference into one where it can’t, I understand why you don’t vote.
Checking Maegan’s registration on the Tarleton State campus in Erath County.
So in 2024 we tried something different. This time, in addition to registering you to vote, we asked if we could stay in touch with you over the course of the election. Our volunteers personally texted with the voters they’d registered to check to make sure they’d received their registration card in the mail, to remind them of the form of I.D. they’d need to bring to vote, to answer questions they might have and to nudge them every day of Early Voting until we could confirm that their ballot had been cast.
The nearly 30,000 voters in our program turned out at twice the rate of other young Texans, 79% to 39%.
So this year we expanded the program, with volunteers and organizers on campuses in East Texas, the Rio Grande Valley, El Paso, Amarillo, Houston, San Marcos, San Antonio, Austin and North Texas, where I just spent the week with our volunteers.
Monday was the University of Arlington, where it topped out at 108-degrees. Our volunteers stayed with it till the end of the day, meeting incoming freshmen, getting them registered and exchanging phone numbers so we could stay in touch over the next few months.
University of North Texas the next day. Tarleton State on Wednesday and Thursday we were at Cedar Valley and Paul Quinn.
I asked every student I met where they were from, what they were studying, what was important to them, what they’d like to change. Majors that stood out, in no order, construction management, animal science, mechanical engineering, agriculture, biology and pre med, criminal justice, information systems, theater and music, English, business, history and political science. Doctors, entrepreneurs, builders, teachers, lawyers, performers and public servants.
Registering students at the University of Texas Arlington.
Nervous first years, trying to fit in and figure it out. Bold idealists believing they can take on the world. Upperclassmen getting ready for the next step.
Tarleton State, which serves a primarily rural student population from Erath and neighboring counties, stood out to me. I met students like Haleigh from Saginaw who’s pursuing animal science with a focus on embryology. She had to go to community college first for basics because her grades weren’t great in high school “I was too focused on my sheep and FFA!” She’s worried about how they’re doing in this heat.
Then there was Maegan from Hico, who is pursuing musical theater degree and hoping to teach music in public schools after she graduates. While I was checking her voter registration she showed me pictures of the adorable 3 year old she’s raising.
Erica came up to me and said “it’s refreshing that you’re here - people are afraid to stand out and we feel better with you all on campus.” She explained that there are more Democrats and independent-minded students on campus than you might expect, but it isn’t always easy to stand out.
Dallas College.
Alanna told me “when we see someone coming to our campus it brings us out of the woodwork.” If you want young people to stand up and be counted, you have to show up and put in the work.
Next, I’ll be organizing with our volunteers at the University of Texas El Paso and then back on the road next week in Austin, San Marcos, San Antonio and other parts of Central Texas. We’ll keep this up through November 3rd.
I’m confident that if this kind of person-to-person organizing, focusing on connecting with young voters, making sure they’re registered and then personally staying in touch with them existed in the years leading up to 2018 we would have won the senate race that year.
It gives me hope that the volunteers who’ve been doing this work in the years since will contribute to a win this time around.
At UNT with a student volunteer.
[**This is the work that works. Can you help me stay on the road by pitching in any amount today?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260829.gIdHiu&refcode=ema20260829-241041&t=3&akid=241041%2E444211%2EpoStTm)
**[Donate $3](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260829.gIdHiu&refcode=ema20260829-241041&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=241041%2E444211%2EpoStTm)**
Together we can get this done.
— Beto

I’m no stranger to being underestimated, Derek. It’s Peggy Flanagan, the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Minnesota. # Newsom's hidden tax is hitting YOUR wallet
---
| Dear Friend,

The other day, I sat down with Fox News to expose something Gavin Newsom doesn't want you to know about.
---
| [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/15Ke_KZWCN7?e=affd398937&c2id=4fd8e839bd16eef39626cb246bcc01d8)
---
| It's called the Vessel at Berth rule. Buried in California's environmental bureaucracy, it forces cargo ships docked at our ports to either plug into state-approved power or pay tens of thousands of dollars a day in fines. Shipping companies aren't eating that cost, you are. California's ports move over 40% of all U.S. container traffic. Every fine gets baked into the price of what's on the truck: your Amazon packages, your groceries, the gas in your tank, the goods on the shelf at your local store. That's not an environmental policy. That's a hidden tax, one Newsom imposed without a single vote in Congress, and one that could spread to ports in every state if we let it stand. I'm not letting it stand. I introduced H.J.Res. 210 to roll back this rule. I am using the Congressional Review Act to force a vote and strike this hidden tax down before it costs families more. As I told Fox News: "It's a massive hidden climate tax that's being imposed on every single ship that's coming into California." Sacramento has an army of bureaucrats and unlimited taxpayer money to defend rules like this one. I have you. Thank you for standing with me. Sincerely

Congressman Vince Fong

We've looked at the polling in every swing state and swing race in the country. It's margin of error, either way, almost everywhere.

At this point, it's not about winning anybody over. _It's about who actually shows up._

If conservatives turn out in November, we'll win every critical battleground and lay the groundwork for victory in 2028 and beyond.

That's why Turning Point Action is focusing all our efforts on three key states: Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.

**We call these states the new RED WALL.**

_Let me explain why they matter so much... _

After 2024, Charlie looked at the numbers, looked at the maps, and told our team something simple. If we lock down Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire, the Left's entire strategy falls apart. Their map collapses. Their path back to power disappears.

Here's why... Winning the presidency comes down to 270 electoral votes. Lose Arizona and most of the realistic paths to the White House in 2028 are gone. Lose Nevada and New Hampshire and the Left rebuilds the Blue Wall they lost in 2024.

Whoever wins in 2028 controls the 2030 Census. The Census drives redistricting. Redistricting sets the congressional map for the next ten years.

This midterm decides which way that goes.

Meet Joe Males:

**Joe Males is a Marine Veteran, small business-owner, city council member, and most importantly, a father. Throughout his life, he has put service to his community at the forefront of his life’s mission.

Shortly after turning 18, Joe enlisted in the Marine Corps. He attended boot camp in Camp Pendleton and later served overseas in the Philippines and Guam. After being discharged as a Sergeant, Joe remained committed to supporting his fellow veterans. He took on leadership roles in his local Elks Lodge and American Legion post, working to ensure veterans in the community had the resources and support they deserved.

Following his time in the Marine Corps, Joe carried his strong work ethic and discipline into the field of computer networking services. He started in an entry-level position, worked his way through multiple leadership roles, and in 1996, he built his own business from the ground up. Joe knows firsthand the hard work and sacrifice of this journey, and he’s determined to make it easier for hardworking Americans to do the same.

Joe’s entry into politics was deeply personal. After his son, a Marine who followed in his footsteps, was tragically murdered back home, Joe vowed that no parent should have to endure such a loss. Determined to take a stand for public safety and the rule of law, he ran for Hemet City Council to help ensure no other family would experience the same tragedy.

During his tenure on the City Council, Joe has led numerous initiatives to improve infrastructure, drive business growth, and keep neighborhoods safe and clean. He takes pride in his ability to collaborate with fellow council members and get results, even when facing different perspectives. Joe is committed to bringing this same results-driven approach to Washington D.C., to ensure the voices of the American people are heard and their needs are met.

Thank you, Joe Males Meet Joe Males: Joe Males is a Marine Veteran, small business-owner, city council member, and most importantly, a father. Throughout his life, he has put service to his community at the forefront of his life’s mission. Shortly after turning 18, Joe enlisted in the Marine Corps. He attended boot camp in Camp Pendleton and later served overseas in the Philippines and Guam. After being discharged as a Sergeant, Joe remained committed to supporting his fellow veterans. He took on leadership roles in his local Elks Lodge and American Legion post, working to ensure veterans in the community had the resources and support they deserved. Following his time in the Marine Corps, Joe carried his strong work ethic and discipline into the field of computer networking services. He started in an entry-level position, worked his way through multiple leadership roles, and in 1996, he built his own business from the ground up. Joe knows firsthand the hard work and sacrifice of this journey, and he’s determined to make it easier for hardworking Americans to do the same. Joe’s entry into politics was deeply personal. After his son, a Marine who followed in his footsteps, was tragically murdered back home, Joe vowed that no parent should have to endure such a loss. Determined to take a stand for public safety and the rule of law, he ran for Hemet City Council to help ensure no other family would experience the same tragedy. During his tenure on the City Council, Joe has led numerous initiatives to improve infrastructure, drive business growth, and keep neighborhoods safe and clean. He takes pride in his ability to collaborate with fellow council members and get results, even when facing different perspectives. Joe is committed to bringing this same results-driven approach to Washington D.C., to ensure the voices of the American people are heard and their needs are met. name: James O'Keefe
subject: WATCH: The Big Murkowski Ballot Scandal
body:
I gave a name that was not mine at an Alaska polling place. No ID. "Absolutely possible." Now the Senator's office wants me prosecuted.
